note: Audit of the existing JARVIS app. The gap analysis compares every candidate against this list.

capabilities.name: Multi-step phone agent
capabilities.detail: Up to 30 steps, reads screen tree and screenshot, stuck and unchanged-screen detection, ambiguity questions
capabilities.limits: Depends on a cloud vision model

capabilities.name: Accessibility control
capabilities.detail: click, long click, type, scroll, drag, pinch, coordinate taps, paste, enter, global actions, deep links

capabilities.name: Wake word
capabilities.detail: Name detection through speech recognition (on-device on Android 13+)
capabilities.limits: No trained keyword model, not as battery-efficient as a dedicated engine

capabilities.name: Speech to text
capabilities.detail: Cloud (Groq, Gemini, OpenAI) and Android on-device SpeechRecognizer
capabilities.limits: Egyptian Arabic accuracy depends on the provider

capabilities.name: Text to speech
capabilities.detail: Cloud voice (Fish Audio) and system TTS
capabilities.limits: Natural Egyptian Arabic voice is limited

capabilities.name: Screen and camera understanding
capabilities.detail: Screenshots and camera frames sent to a multimodal model

capabilities.name: Dedicated OCR
capabilities.limits: Relies on accessibility text and a cloud vision model

capabilities.name: Long-term memory
capabilities.detail: Encrypted JSON store, embeddings search, summaries, learned skills and macros, GitHub sync and restore

capabilities.name: Model routing
capabilities.detail: Sequential provider fallback with cooldowns (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, local server, FreeLLMAPI)
capabilities.limits: No cost or latency aware routing

capabilities.name: Offline LLM
capabilities.detail: Only an external llama.cpp server URL
capabilities.limits: No on-device inference inside the app

capabilities.name: Study mode and auto reply
capabilities.detail: Calls and WhatsApp replies, per-contact styles, urgent detection

capabilities.name: Secure storage and locks
capabilities.detail: Android Keystore encryption, device credential lock, wipe

capabilities.name: Autonomous engineer
capabilities.detail: Problem reports, diagnosis, fix branch, tests, pull request for approval

capabilities.name: Retrieval over documents
capabilities.limits: Embeddings only over the assistant's own memory
